excerpt: How Gen Z is Redefining Recruitment and Job Search Approaches Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Generation Z, born roughly between 1997 and 2012, is the newest generation entering the workforce, and they are already reshaping how employers attract, recruit, and retain talent. From demanding flexible work models to prioritizing mental health and meaningful work, Gen Z candidates have unique expectations that differ from previous generations.
